notes:
- Every gun has a new, realistic model (from Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0; the authors are in the Credits):
  Vanguard AR, Rattler SMG, Boomstick, Grinder LMG, Tri-Burst, Hornet PDW, Stalker 12, Twin Barrels,
  Warden DMR, Mag-50, Buzzsaw, Thumper, Bolt Thrower and Hand Cannon. Their real magazines, pumps, slides,
  bolts, break-open barrels, spinning barrels and revolver cylinder move when you reload. Attachments and
  camos work on all of them (camos now also cover slides, barrels, pumps and the cylinder).
- Prestige tokens. Prestiging a gun now locks its attachments again (they unlock as it levels back
  up), and gives a token: use it in the Gunsmith to keep one attachment unlocked on that gun for good.
  An account prestige locks the guns again until you level back up to them, and gives a token that keeps
  one gun unlocked for good. Camos, cosmetics, weapon levels and stats stay. If you prestiged before, you
  already have a token for each prestige.
- Touch controls for phones and tablets (a move stick, drag to look, on-screen buttons), for the Android
  test build. Online co-op and voice aren't on Android yet.
- Under the hood: the game's code is split into smaller files in tidy folders.
